facts.text: 10,000 volts. Please do not touch or lean on the fences.
facts.why: The film shows the park fence barrier with a sign reading DANGER 10,000 Volts, so the figure is right and the warning fits.
facts.fix: Electric fences. Please do not touch or lean on them.
